components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact glass-dark conversion action with a signal arrow disc, used in hero and closing awakening chapters.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:fit-content; min-height:58px; padding:7px 8px 7px 24px; color:var(--white, #f5f3ed); background:rgba(245,243,237,.045); border:1px solid rgba(245,243,237,.28); border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07); text-decoration:none; font:720 .82rem/1.55 "Work Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing:.01em; backdrop-filter:blur(14px); transition:transform 220ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary-action::after { content:">"; display:grid; place-items:center; width:42px; height:42px; margin-left:22px; color:var(--black, #030608); background:var(--signal, #78f3ce); border-radius:50%; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1; transition:transform 220ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:rgba(120,243,206,.08); border-color:rgba(120,243,206,.62); } .ds-primary-action:hover::after { transform:translateX(2px); background:var(--white, #f5f3ed); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sport-accent, #24d3a2); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Header Action
components.description: Restrained pill conversion action reserved for the fixed header.
components.css: .ds-header-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; color:var(--white, #f5f3ed); background:transparent; border:1px solid rgba(245,243,237,.52); border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; font:700 .78rem/1.55 "Work Sans", sans-serif; transition:color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-header-action:hover { color:var(--black, #030608); background:var(--white, #f5f3ed); border-color:var(--white, #f5f3ed); } .ds-header-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sport-accent, #24d3a2); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Sport Selector
components.description: Ruled row of borderless sport choices with one active signal color.
components.css: .ds-sport-selector { display:flex; gap:0 20px; border-block:1px solid var(--line, rgba(245,243,237,.2)); overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none; } .ds-sport-selector::-webkit-scrollbar { display:none; } .ds-sport-selector button { flex:0 0 auto; min-height:48px; padding:0; color:#7d8d88; background:transparent; border:0; cursor:pointer; font:700 .75rem/1.55 "Work Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-sport-selector button:hover { color:var(--white, #f5f3ed); } .ds-sport-selector button[aria-pressed="true"] { color:var(--sport-accent, #24d3a2); } .ds-sport-selector button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sport-accent, #24d3a2); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview:
DoThis is a nocturnal arena in the instant before an athlete returns to motion. Near-black full-viewport chapters, disciplined white type, and life-size campaign portrait planes create recognition and tension before the page explains anything. Emerald arrives as a rare signal of readiness, not a decorative brand wash.

The visual system is sparse and identity-first. Work Sans delivers compressed, uppercase commands; italic Cormorant Garamond carries the private inner voice. Real Today, Workout, and Progress screens appear only as a restrained three-screen glimpse, preserving mystery while making the App Store action credible.
keyCharacteristics: Nocturnal arena-black chapters with subtle green-black tonal shifts.
Athlete campaign portraits treated as full-height spatial planes.
Monumental Work Sans commands cut by intimate italic Cormorant Garamond lines.
Emerald signal color used for awakening language, focus, selection, and action.
Full-viewport pacing with one emotional job per chapter.
One coherent sport state across portrait, whisper, accent, URL, and App Store route.
Three real product screens staged as physical evidence, never a feature gallery.

rules.name: The Signal Stays Rare Rule
rules.body: Emerald marks awakening, choice, focus, or action; it does not become ambient decoration or a broad background field.

rules.name: The Sport State Is Whole Rule
rules.body: A sport choice changes portrait, whisper, accent, URL state, and every App Store action together; never change one part alone.

rules.name: The Outer-and-Inner Voice Rule
rules.body: Work Sans commands in public; italic Cormorant Garamond reveals what the athlete already knows.

rules.name: The Narrow Command Rule
rules.body: Monumental statements remain between roughly 7ch and 13ch so scale creates impact without becoming a banner.

rules.name: The One Beat Per Viewport Rule
rules.body: Each chapter carries one emotional beat: promise, recognition, sport choice, product proof, or wake-up command.

rules.name: The Glimpse, Not Gallery Rule
rules.body: Show exactly the restrained Today, Workout, and Progress trio at readable scale; do not expand the homepage into a feature grid.

rules.name: The Evidence Owns Depth Rule
rules.body: Persistent shadow belongs to real product evidence; atmosphere elsewhere comes from black-on-black layering and portrait gradients.

rules.name: The No Card Chrome Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce rounded content cards, glass panels, or floating feature tiles into the open arena composition.

dos: Do keep Second Awakening nocturnal, sparse, identity-first, and paced in full-viewport chapters.
Do use approved athlete campaign portraits as large spatial planes and real simulator captures as product evidence.
Do preserve the Work Sans and italic Cormorant Garamond outer/inner voice split.
Do keep portrait, whisper, active accent, URL state, and App Store destination synchronized for all six sport states.
Do preserve 44px minimum touch targets, 3px focus outlines, keyboard sport selection, meaningful non-JavaScript content, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't revive the previous warm-paper identity or dense explanatory chapters.
Don't broaden emerald into a decorative wash or mix multiple sport accents in one state.
Don't turn the three-screen glimpse into a product gallery, dashboard, or carousel.
Don't fabricate, repaint, crop away, or visually modify product UI; screenshots are evidence.
Don't add generic fitness imagery, glassmorphism, rounded-card grids, gradients unrelated to portrait integration, testimonials, metrics, medical outcomes, or unsupported product claims.
